t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the colour of the gnomes will always come in pairs and some gnomes get more points than others. It is a good idea to make a note of which colour gets more mushrooms. It is also a good idea to try a different colour when the multiplier is at 1x not 5x

vb_textbox.text: You will get between 1 and 7 points usually when the multiplier is 1x so its a good idea to work out which gnomes gives the most points. The gnomes are always shown in pairs so it becomes easier as the experiment goes on to work out which ones are the highest points. From my experience, I found that the Brown, Red, Orange and Green gnomes gave the highest points but that was not always true so test it out yourself
